exactly_once.detail: This worker does not have exactly-once source support enabled.

follow_ups.text: This release publishes the Debezium-compatible envelope only (`before`, `after`, `source`, `op`); the Confluent-compatible flat format (`cdc.output.format=confluent`) is not built yet. Records change shape and keys become structs of the key columns, so consumers and schemas of the existing table topics break. Point `cdc.topic.template` at new topic names and move consumers to the new format, or wait for the Confluent-compatible format before cutting over.

Record keys are structs of the key columns (Debezium style). Confluent's key template (default `${primaryKeyStructOrValue}`, a plain value for a single-column key) has no equivalent; consumers and compacted topics keyed by the old form must change.

DATE columns are published as `io.debezium.time.Timestamp` (milliseconds) with the time of day kept, or as ISO text with `cdc.temporal.mode=iso_string`. Consumers that read Confluent's DATE mapping must change.
Part of Confluent's record format, which this release does not produce. See the record format follow-up.

Confluent's documentation describes `${databaseName}` and `${fullyQualifiedTableName}` loosely. Compare the topic names the translated `cdc.topic.template` produces with the existing topics before cutting over.

The redo log topic (`redo.log.topic.name`, default `${connectorName}-${databaseName}-redo-log`) stops receiving data at the cutover (MIG-5). Move or retire its consumers, then delete it after the agreed retention.

Set `cdc.start.scn` before the new connector first runs: stop the old connector, then run `takeover_scn.py`, which reads its offset, checks the archived logs and writes `cdc.start.scn` into this configuration. Without it the new connector starts at the current SCN and changes made since the old connector stopped are lost.

The target Connect cluster does not have exactly-once source support enabled (This worker does not have exactly-once source support enabled.), so the connector delivers at least once. To deliver exactly once, set `exactly.once.source.support=enabled` on every worker, then add `exactly.once.support=required` and `transaction.boundary=connector`.

next_steps: Resolve the follow-ups, above all the record format, then run `oracle-cdc-doctor check --config config.json`.
Stop the Confluent connector with `PUT /connectors/confluent-oracle-cdc/stop`; pausing is not enough, the offset must be final.
Run `takeover_scn.py --target-config config.json` to read the Confluent offset, check the archived logs and write `cdc.start.scn` into the configuration.
Create `confluent-oracle-cdc-oso` from that configuration. With no stored offset it starts streaming at `cdc.start.scn`.
Point dashboards and alerts at the connector's JMX metrics; the names differ from Confluent's (see the metrics reference).
Remove the redo log topic and the old connector's other topics after the agreed retention.
